tool_args.rationale: The bullwhip and flux-conservation signatures point toward a bridged supply mechanism, but the pilot sweep alone cannot distinguish its dependence on the other variables from competing nonlinear laws. The open-branch probe targets that ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a stationary model to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Only u_now varies, so dependence on the other inputs and the bridged mechanism is not identifiable.
A targeted branch-discriminating probe is cheaper and better suited to resolving the present ambiguity.
It does not address the mechanism ambiguity.
